description:
This Is How It’s Made! Korea’s Finest Bowl Passed Down Through Generations

Hello, this is King Process.
Today, we are taking a look at traditional Korean bowls and cast iron cauldrons that are made to be used for generations.
This video features Geochang Yugi, a Korean brassware maker that has continued its craft since 1924, and Anseong Jumul, known for traditional cast iron cauldrons made with more than 100 years of history.
These are not products simply made quickly by machines.
They are traditional Korean vessels shaped by skilled hands, long experience, and a craft that has been passed down over time.
From golden brass bowls to heavy cast iron cauldrons,
we show how Korean traditional tableware and cookware are made to last for a lifetime and beyond.
Thank you for watching.

1. A golden bowl that has been around for a thousand years. The process of making traditional Korean bowls

2. Best Cauldron in Korea. Cauldron masters with 100 years of history
